title: Compute exact statistics over 150k events within a wall-clock budget

prompt.zh: events.ndjson 是 15 万条 CI 构建事件。请严格按 REPORT_SPEC.md 编写 solve.mjs（Node、无第三方依赖，读取数据并写出 report.json），再运行它生成 report.json。注意规格中的每个定义：nearest-rank 百分位、half-up 舍入、并列时的决胜规则、键的排序。评分器会在 15 秒预算内运行你的 solve.mjs 并逐字段比对——先想清楚复杂度，避免超时。不要修改 events.ndjson 或 REPORT_SPEC.md。
prompt.en: events.ndjson holds 150k CI build events. Write solve.mjs strictly per REPORT_SPEC.md (Node, no third-party dependencies, reads the data and writes report.json), then run it. Every definition matters: nearest-rank percentiles, half-up rounding, tie-breaking rules, key ordering. The verifier runs your solve.mjs under a 15-second wall-clock budget and compares every field — think about complexity first, timeouts score zero on computed fields. Do not modify events.ndjson or REPORT_SPEC.md.
